title: RIT Pep Band
description: RIT Pep Band is a band that plays at NCAA D1 RIT Hockey games as well as other sporting events in the Rochester area, occasionally. We contribute to one of the best atmospheres in college hockey and have a great time hyping up the crowd. I play trombone and am Treasurer of the band for the 2026-27 school year. I manage the band's accounting book and inventory, as well as running fundraising and repairs.
altText: Eboard of RIT Pep Band tabling at Club Fair, Logan is in the bottom left

title: RIT Improv
description: RIT Improv runs biweekly improv workshops open to any students of any skill level, as well as free improv comedy shows every other friday night. I have participated in 4 myself, but I mostly just go to workshops as a fun way to unwind and learn to think on my feet. Improv is both a useful everyday soft skill AND it's fun.

title: FM Radio Show
description: I run an FM radio show called Tales From The CD Shelf every Tuesday from 3:30PM to 5:30PM on WITR 89.7FM in Rochester. It's a fun little show where I show off CDs that I personally own and why I own them. Mostly, it's an excuse to practice public speaking and show off my music taste.
altText: Logan in the FM studio with two guests

title: RIT Game Symphony Orchestra
description: RIT has an orchestra of around 200 members dedicated to playing video game music. I am a member because the difficulty of the music pushes me to be better at trombone. I also run a Small Ensemble every semester, which is where people get together groups of 2-15 musicians to play a specific video game song. I arrange the music for my own ensembles as a hobby. Fall 2026 I am running a song from Skylanders: SWAP Force, which is a game I played as a small child.
